name: Marcus Chen
psychographics: Prioritizes quality and sustainability; will pay extra for ethically sourced food but hates wasted fridge space
current_solutions: Instacart for weekly basics; habit of ordering lunch from the same bodega near his office; keeps a minimalist fridge
frustration: His smart fridge alarm went off at 2am last Tuesday because the vegetable drawer was 2°C too warm, spoiling a $40 batch of prepped salads
decision_style: reads deep-dive reviews on Reddit's r/foodprep, then orders via the app with one click
voice: rambling tech-jargon; mixes metric and imperial units casually; frequently starts sentences with 'so the thing is...'
